segments.visible_description: A comic warning distinguishes merely attaching sources from actually checking them.
segments.narration: Use current guidance from the organizations and researchers who publish it.

segments.visible_description: Elle stands in the library with the verification rulebook beside official source shelves.
segments.narration: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Stanford guidance becomes three moves you can use.

segments.visible_description: Move One shows the source, policy and current pricing being handed to the model.
segments.narration: Move one: give her the source; paste the current document or turn on search when freshness matters.

segments.visible_description: Elle brings a real file and points to its timeline in court.
segments.narration: Tell the model to answer only from the material you supplied; Elle walks in with the file.

segments.visible_description: Move Two explicitly allows an honest I don't know and labels inference.
segments.narration: Move two: let her say I don't know.

segments.visible_description: A receipt card defines evidence as something the user can open, name, date, quote or point to.
segments.narration: If the answer is not in the source, say so rather than guessing to be helpful.

segments.visible_description: Move Three highlights the exact supporting sentence in the supplied document.
segments.narration: Move three: make it show the line, including the exact sentence and the missing Spring Fling identification.

segments.visible_description: The No Invented Receipts card rejects made-up links, dates, quotes, numbers and policies.
segments.narration: No invented receipts and no made-up links, dates, quotes or numbers.

segments.visible_description: The complete Prompt Like Elle page assembles all three moves and the receipt rule.
segments.narration: Watch the method work in the complete prompt: use only the sources, mark what is pending and show the line.

editorial_decision: Replace four long method-card holds with nine narration-specific beats that move from trusted sources through the three Prompt Like Elle moves and into the worked example.
